arguments.summary: Customer Marcus Thompson (user_id mt35a7c9d2) completed identity verification (DOB 03/15/1990, phone 206-555-3842, email marcus.thompson@techdev.io). Customer reports three debit-card declines today with CODE 05. They located their cards and unfroze the Blue card in-app; card now shows Active. Customer believes declines are due to a velocity block after multiple purchases yesterday and requests that the velocity block be cleared immediately so they can process a business lunch payment (~$85) at a Seattle restaurant. Please investigate and clear any velocity/security block or advise next steps.

proposals.text: I’ve transferred you to our security team and provided a summary (they have your verification on file). A human agent will assist you shortly — they can clear the velocity block or advise next steps. Is there anything else I can do while you wait?
